rounds.title: Practice round
rounds.note: These books are made up. Swipe around to get the feel of it. Nothing here counts.

items.name: The Moon Owes Me Twelve Dollars
items.bio: We met in fifth grade. You laughed at page 40 and never told me why. Still not mad about the twelve dollars.

items.name: Captain Pickle and the Sock Thieves
items.bio: Short, funny, a little crunchy. Looking for someone who still believes socks go missing on purpose.

items.name: Field Guide to Suspicious Garden Bugs
items.bio: I know 41 beetles by name. Not all of them are friends. Swipe right if you still check under rocks.

items.name: Algebra 2: Now With More Letters
items.bio: I was there for every late night. You never once enjoyed me. I respect the honesty.

items.name: Twelve Summers at Juniper Lake
items.bio: We both cried on page 301. Comes with a sand stain and a bookmark from a pizza place.

items.name: Knots, Loops and Lanyards
items.bio: Taught you the box stitch. Somewhere out there is a keychain that proves it.
